notice_sections:
## Playwright security profiles

The unmodified `scripts/security/playwright-1.64.0.seccomp` and the derived
`scripts/security/playwright-1.64.0.chromium-chroot.seccomp` originate from
[Playwright's profile](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/606ecd8b34bac100db32561b6278ffd76e5eb3cd/utils/docker/seccomp_profile.json),
commit `606ecd8b34bac100db32561b6278ffd76e5eb3cd`.
The upstream rights holder is Microsoft Corporation; the full Apache-2.0 text
and upstream NOTICE are retained as [Playwright-Apache-2.0.txt](licenses/Playwright-Apache-2.0.txt)
and [Playwright-NOTICE.txt](licenses/Playwright-NOTICE.txt).
Preserve both notices with distributed copies. The upstream NOTICE also credits
Puppeteer-derived code and is retained in full without attributing that code to Jevelopers.

The derived profile adds the single documented unconditional `chroot` allowance;
its modification and unchanged base are recorded in the
[security policy documentation](scripts/security/README.md). It is not represented
as an unchanged official profile. This licensing update modifies neither profile.
## Noto fixture fonts

| Component | Original copyright / license | Local paths and full notice | Upstream / provenance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Noto Sans static composition font | Font metadata: Copyright 2015-2021 Google LLC. All Rights Reserved.; upstream notice: Copyright 2018 The Noto Project Authors; SIL OFL 1.1 | `src/assets/fonts/composition-noto-sans.ttf`; preserve [composition-noto-sans-OFL.txt](src/assets/fonts/composition-noto-sans-OFL.txt) | [Pinned source and hashes](docs/composition/FONTS.md) |
| Noto Sans Latin calibration subset | Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors; SIL OFL 1.1 | `src/assets/fonts/noto-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2`; preserve [OFL.txt](src/assets/fonts/OFL.txt) | [Runtime pins](docs/runtime/pins.json) |

Package-manager font dependencies retain their own notices when included in an
output. Fixture permission is not customer font approval. Neither existing font
nor OFL text is modified, and no font-delivery constraint is relaxed.
## Unicode data

The existing notice is Unicode License V3 (SPDX `Unicode-3.0`). Preserve the complete existing [Unicode license](docs/production-output/UNICODE-LICENSE.txt)
with the corresponding data and derived material. It identifies Copyright ©
1991-2026 Unicode, Inc. Its terms, rather than the project notice, govern the
covered Unicode material. [Unicode upstream terms](https://www.unicode.org/license.txt).
## Pinned shared-contracts archive notices

Preserve the `vendor/shared-contracts/jevelopers-shared-contracts-0.9.4.tgz` and
`vendor/shared-contracts/jevelopers-shared-contracts-0.9.7.tgz` archives byte-for-byte at their existing source pins.
Each contains `package/generated/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with the complete MIT
notices for Ajv 8.17.1 (Copyright (c) 2015-2021 Evgeny Poberezkin) and
fast-deep-equal 3.1.3 (Copyright (c) 2017 Evgeny Poberezkin).
Preserve those actual embedded notices in copies and extracted distributions.
The source packages are maintained by [shared-contracts](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/shared-contracts);
its older first-party snapshots are not relicensed by this repository's MIT grant.
